details:
AstroQuest Morocco 2026 – Space Rescue Adventure

Project Overview

AstroQuest is an interactive, browser-based educational game designed for children aged 7–12. It was developed in response to the NASA Space Apps Challenge “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.”

The game introduces young learners to the challenges of living and working beyond Earth through interactive storytelling, scientific decision-making, and practical activities.

How It Works

Players begin by selecting their language (Arabic, English, or French), astronaut identity, destination (Moon or Mars), and mission role.

They then complete space-related missions involving:

  • Life Support: Managing oxygen, energy, and crew safety.
  • Shelter Preparation: Identifying essential supplies such as water, food, oxygen, and medical equipment.
  • Electrical Repairs: Connecting matching wires to repair a circuit.
  • Emergency Communication: Preparing and sending an SOS message.
  • Space Agriculture: Planting seeds, providing water, and managing lighting.

Each mission combines decision-making questions with interactive activities. Players receive explanations about their choices and earn points as they progress.

Technology Used

AstroQuest was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It runs directly in a web browser without requiring installation. Netlify is used to host the game online.

AI-assisted tools were used during development for coding support, visual design, and educational content drafting.

Creativity and Educational Value

AstroQuest transforms scientific challenges into interactive adventures. Instead of only reading about astronaut life, children can make decisions and practice solving problems in a simulated space environment.

The project encourages curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving while making space science more accessible.

Intended Impact

Our goal is to inspire children to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), develop an interest in space exploration, and build confidence in making thoughtful decisions.

Play AstroQuest: https://poetic-pasca-7cd8f4.netlify.app
